System_Purpose: Assist service operations staff with retrieval summarization drafting and work-order support
User_Groups: Operations Staff; Service Managers; Dispatch Team
AI_Functions: Retrieve procedures; summarize service history; draft customer emails; prepare work-order notes; suggest follow-up tasks
Allowed_Actions: Retrieve approved documents; summarize existing records; draft text for human review; identify missing service documentation
Prohibited_Actions: Approve purchases; modify billing records; issue refunds; change contracts; dispatch technicians without review; access HR files
Data_Sources: SharePoint procedures; Teams content; customer service records; work-order notes; technician reports; vendor documentation
Sensitive_Data_Types: Customer contact info; service history; technician notes; building access details; internal pricing
Identity_Model: Named user access with controlled service identity
Permissions_Model: Role-based access with least privilege target
Evidence_Retained: Prompt/output logs; source references; approval notes; user activity logs
Known_Risks: Over-permissioned data access; inaccurate drafts; weak evidence trail; unclear ownership; outdated source material
Control_Gaps: Formal access review incomplete; evidence retention policy undefined; approval workflow not yet automated
Notes: Initial synthetic system record for FORGE 001 baseline
